messages:
Taylor Morgan: hey all  quick Q for my first week: where should I keep private ramp notes vs the official team onboarding pages? also need to know who owns the 'Customer-facing Onboarding Checklist' template so I can ask for edits. cc @Rhea
Rhea Singh: welcome Taylor! Private notes -> My Workspace (Personal). Official onboarding lives in Company Wiki > Docs Library > Teams > Customer Success. If you want teammates to collaborate, move to Team > New Hires or share your page.
Owen Park: if you only need a small tweak for your role, duplicate the template and edit your copy. If you want to change the canonical template, request edit access so we keep an audit trail.
Taylor Morgan: is there a super quick Slack snippet I can paste to request edit access (trying to avoid the full form while setting up laptop)
DocsHelp Bot: quick snippet (paste in #devex):
```
@DocsHelp request-edit --page "https://notion.redwood.company/Company/Docs/Customer-Success/Onboarding/Customer-facing-Checklist" --reason "add B2B setup steps" --cc @Rhea
```
That creates a ticket and notifies the Docs rotation.
Carmen Diaz: FYI templates show owner in the header. If it says "Owner: unassigned" add a page comment like "@team-docs can someone pick this up?" and we'll triage. For anything that affects customers, please request canonical edits (so legal/comms can review).
Taylor Morgan: filed the snippet, got ticket DOC-11077. one more: any recommended 1:1 template for CS ICs?
Rhea Singh: Templates > New Hire Toolkit > CS 1:1 Agenda and CS 30/60/90. Duplicate and prefix with your name. If you want your manager added as an editor, tag me and I'll add them. :wave:
Owen Park: small housekeeping tip: when you duplicate a canonical page, add a short banner at the top: "Derived from Customer-facing Checklist v1.0 - do not edit source" so maintainers know it's a fork.
Taylor Morgan: perfect, thanks everyone! saved me a ton of guesswork. :raised_hands:
